dialogues.text: Hello! Welcome to Lumbridge. I've been the curator of this fine town for many years now.

options.text: How long have you lived here?

dialogues.text: Lumbridge is a fine town indeed! We have a grand castle, a church, and even a general store. Many adventurers start their journey here.
Oh, I've been here for as long as I can remember! I know every cobblestone in this town. I take great pride in keeping Lumbridge a safe place for new adventurers.
Well, you could explore the area around Lumbridge. There are trees to chop, fishing spots by the river, and even some chickens if you're looking to practice your combat skills!

options.text: Tell me more about the area.
